title: 호텔+미우 통합게시판 주문입력 — 이미지/텍스트 합산 후 주문수량만 가산

actions.name: PARSE_IMAGE_OR_TEXT
actions.sideEffect: read Product + order-mappings.json + WebHotelMiuProductMap overlay. No persistImportMatchMappings. No Order/Shipment write.

actions.name: SAVE_BOARD_PRODUCT_MAP
actions.sideEffect: INSERT WebHotelMiuProductMap overlay only. Does not write data/order-mappings.json.

actions.name: FAVORITE_CUSTOMER_WEEK
actions.sideEffect: UserFavorite page=hotel-miu-board stores custKey+year+week. Ledger preserve.

actions.name: REGISTER_ORDER_ADD
actions.sideEffect: POST /api/orders source=hotel-miu-board isDelta add for selected OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey+ProdKey. ShipmentMaster is not ensured (not raum-pnl). Then INSERT WebHotelMiuIntakeBatch+Line as 1차/2차. Cross-year same OrderWeek is excluded.

actions.name: REVISE_BATCH_INCREASE
actions.sideEffect: batchQtyDelta positive qty is sent to createOrder as signed add. WebHotelMiuIntakeLine replaced for that BatchKey scoped by OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey. Shipment preserve.

actions.name: REVISE_BATCH_DECREASE
actions.sideEffect: batchQtyDelta negative qty is sent to createOrder as signed subtract. Does not write Shipment*/Estimate/WebProfitReport.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025와 2026의 동일 차수(예: 33-01)라도 화면 연도+차수+CustKey만 조회·가산한다. 전년도 Master를 재사용하지 않는다.
